outcome: The browser client hosted at app.example.com can call the API directly instead of proxying through its own origin.

acceptance_criteria.text: A request from https://app.example.com is allowed to send and receive credentials.

expected_verification.assertion: the app origin is echoed and credentials are allowed

acceptance_criteria.text: No origin other than https://app.example.com is allowed to send credentials.

expected_verification.assertion: an unknown origin receives no credentialed CORS grant

security_impact: Changes who may read authenticated responses.
